description:
The JSON kit: an out-of-the-box JSON viewer on the tree view (RFC 0050
        · Episode 3). DOMAIN-SIDE code that ships, as the stock cells do: a
        JSON value is exactly what a relation holds and a tree never sees — a
        relation that answers a value's PLACES, object members and array
        elements by JSON-pointer key, lazily under the fold; a cell per node
        that draws the key and the value in the theme's colour; and a viewer
        that composes the two over a RelTree for a host that wants one line.
        The tree is not changed for it, and could not be: the kit is a consumer
        of rel-tree, one crate over, holding values as any domain does.

        Depends on rel-tree, and through it on the channel's core and the
        family's protocol.
